solvers_verified.continuum_2d_fea: MultiTopologyContinuumSolver (Total Lagrangian with B-bar shear-locking relief)

discrepancies_reconciled.prior_claim: Phase 15 reported 73% FEA reduction (10.8 vs 40.0 calls) based on synthetic formulas.
discrepancies_reconciled.verified_truth: Phase 16 executed genuine FEA solver calls, finding mean calls: 8.80 (Classical) vs 7.00 (Classical+Surrogate) vs 5.00 (CASM+Surrogate). CASM has a 28.57% advantage over Classical+Surrogate.
discrepancies_reconciled.open_risk: CASM 5.00 calls was partially achieved by failing earlier on Tasks M & P. Must be resolved via fair budget and failure-aware metrics.

discrepancies_reconciled.prior_claim: Phase 15 claimed 0 false feasibility across 75 cases with ~4.8% Clopper-Pearson CI.
discrepancies_reconciled.verified_truth: Among the 25 accepted cases, 0 errors occurred, which corresponds to a 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound of 13.72% risk, not 4.8%. Across all 75 evaluations, the system-level false certification rate is <= 4.80%.
discrepancies_reconciled.open_risk: Statistical conformal bounds must never be advertised as deterministic structural safety guarantees.

discrepancies_reconciled.prior_claim: All optimizations previously searched only across 8 fixed prismatic topology templates with uniform thickness.
discrepancies_reconciled.verified_truth: Phase 17 breaks this limit by introducing the Topology Innovation Engine (tapered flexures, serpentine curvature, and intermediate floating shuttles).
discrepancies_reconciled.open_risk: New geometries must maintain valid load paths, non-crossing elements, and beam model validity.
